slides.title: Taj pe naam likh ke kya mila?
College trip, Agra.
slides.body:
Bunty, Pinky aur poori gang.
Sadiyon purani marble ki deewar.
Bunty: "Yaadgaar toh banana padega na."

slides.title: Chaabi nikali. Kharoch diya.
slides.body: "Sab likhte hain. Ek naam se kya hoga?"

slides.title: Ek naam. Phir sau. Phir hazaar.
slides.body: Deewar pe naamon ka jungle. Saaf karne mein mehnat aur public paisa lagta hai.

slides.title: Pinky: "Kya mila, Bunty?"
slides.body: "Sadiyon purani deewar pe 5 second ka nishaan. Aur kisi ko yaad bhi nahi Bunty kaun tha."

slides.title: Ye sirf galat nahi, offence hai.
slides.body: Protected monument ko kharochna, todna ya deface karna kaanoon ke under saza wala offence hai.
slides.small:
Source: Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites
and Remains Act, 1958, Section 30.

slides.title: Asli Indian tourist kaun?
slides.body:
Taj pe roz hazaaron log aate hain.
Zyada-tar bas photo lete hain
aur kuch nahi chhodte.
Wahi asli yaadgaar hai.

slides.title: Monument rule:
slides.body:
Yaad lo, nishaan nahi.
Photo lo, chaabi nahi.
Dost likhe toh tok do.

slides.title: Ab Bunty ka naam kahan hai?
slides.body: Photo mein. Deewar saaf. "Yaad camera mein, monument sabke liye."

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo har monument pe apna naam chhod aata hai.
